title: Privacy
lede: What this site does and does not keep about you.
desc: How Everett Allen Photography counts visits and handles information from forms and client galleries.
body:
**Visit counts.** This site counts page views and daily visitors so I can see which galleries people enjoy. It uses no cookies and no advertising or tracking services. It does not store your IP address or browser details. A one-way scrambled code is used to tell whether a visit is new today, and it is deleted the next day. If your browser sends a Do Not Track signal, nothing is counted.

**Forms.** If you use the contact form or the new client form, I receive what you type and use it only to reply and to plan your session. I do not sell or share it.

**Client galleries.** Private galleries use a single cookie to keep you signed in to your own gallery. Nothing else is tracked there.

**Questions or removal.** Please [get in touch](/contact/) if you want something removed or have a question.
